description: PatSnap all-in-one Engineering Agents platform for Codex — hosts product-and-engineering team agents and skills in one plugin.

interface.shortDescription: All-in-one platform for product & engineering team agents and skills
interface.longDescription: Engineering Agents is PatSnap's unified Codex plugin for the full product-and-engineering team. It hosts specialized agents (coding, security, and more over time) and reusable skills (issue pipeline, security review, project install) in one place. Install once via the plugin marketplace; optionally vendor agents into a git repo for team-wide consistency.
